caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a wooden hand tool resembling a clamp or vice, centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The tool consists of two elongated, curved jaws with a natural wood grain texture and brownish coloring. The jaws are connected at one end by a horizontal axle, which is secured with visible metallic fasteners. At the right end, the jaws are paired with two rounded, reddish-brown handles. A metallic spiral spring or coil wraps around a portion of the handles, providing tension between the handles. There is a signature and some small text in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Bootjack
